gemini_description.purpose: To provide critical installation, site placement, and electrical wiring instructions for a water pump (such as a swimming pool pump) to ensure safe and correct operation.
gemini_description.summary: This document outlines the essential guidelines for the physical location of the water pump, safety warnings, general electrical connections, and specific requirements for both single-phase and three-phase motor configurations to prevent electrical hazards and protect the equipment.

components.name: Water Pump (المضخة)
components.description: The main mechanical device used to pump water, typically for swimming pools.

components.name: Primary Filter / Pre-filter (المرشح الأولي)
components.description: Component that must be primed with water before starting the pump to ensure correct operation.

components.name: Suction Pipe (ماسورة الشط)
components.description: The intake line through which water rises to reach the pump.

components.name: Electric Motor (المحرك)
components.description: The power unit driving the pump, available in either single-phase or three-phase configurations.

components.name: Disconnect Device (جهاز فصل)
components.description: An omnipolar isolation switch with at least 3 mm of contact separation to disconnect the pump from the mains.

components.name: Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter / Breaker (قاطع دائرة أعطال الأرضي)
components.description: A safety device adjusted to match the electrical current rating of the pump.

components.name: Fuses (المنصهر / الفيوز)
components.description: Overcurrent protection devices that must be verified before connecting the motor.

components.name: Grounding Cable (كابل الأرضي)
components.description: A safety cable connected to the ground to prevent electric shock.

components.name: Connection Sleeve / Gland (جلبة توصيل)
components.description: Specifically a H07 RN-F3 type sleeve used for electrical cable connections.

procedure: Priming: Fill and prime the pump's pre-filter (primary filter) until water rises through the suction pipe before starting.
Placement: Install the pump below the swimming pool water level to optimize its performance.
Environmental Protection: Ensure the pump is located in a dry, ventilated area and protected from potential flooding.
Electrical Isolation: Install an omnipolar disconnection device with a contact separation of at least 3 mm to isolate the pump from the mains power.

Power Cable Connection: Use a robust cable to connect the pump to the main electrical supply. If using a flexible cable, terminate it with terminal eyelets for secure connection to the motor terminals.
Safety Device Setup: Adjust the ground fault circuit breaker to match the pump's rated current.
Fuse Check: Verify that the correct fuse types are installed before connecting the motor to the power source.
Grounding: Verify the wiring sequence and connect the grounding cable securely to the pump.
Compliance: Ensure all electrical wiring adheres to local regulatory codes and technical guidelines.

technical_details.detail: Contact separation for the electrical disconnect device must be at least 3 mm.
For single-phase motors: Equipped with built-in thermal protection. Must be fitted with a motor protector with magnetic protection. Set the thermal relay values based on specifications.

Single-phase voltage specification: 230V (noted in text as '032 فولت' due to a numerical reversal typo). Connection requires a H07 RN-F3 cable sleeve with a cross-section appropriate for the motor power and cable length.
For three-phase motors: Must use a motor protector with magnetic protection. Protect the pump from overloads using a circuit breaker.
Three-phase Delta connection (Δ): Specified for 3 x 230V (written as 3 x 032V), requiring the use of the highest indicated protection device value from the thermal protection table.
Three-phase Star connection (Y): Specified for 3 x 400V (written as 3 x 004V), requiring the use of the lowest indicated protection device value from the thermal protection table.

warnings.warning: Failure to comply with technical and electrical connection guidelines voids the manufacturer's warranty and releases them from liability.
Improper connection to the mains supply poses a critical risk of electrical shock.
The pump must be installed in a well-ventilated, dry area protected against any risk of flooding.
